title: Little paws, big journeys
subtitle: Cat travel preparation, from Jordan to forever homes around the world.
note: These steps apply to most European countries and many countries worldwide, but requirements may vary by destination.

steps.title: Microchip & rabies vaccine
steps.body: The journey starts at the vet in Jordan.

steps.title: Blood sample
steps.body: Sent to an EU-approved lab in Germany for the rabies titer test.

steps.title: Ready to fly
steps.body: Counted from the blood sample date, once the result is good.

items.label: DHL blood sample shipment
items.note: Same price for 2 cats or more

dhl_title: More cats to the same country, lower DHL cost per cat
dhl_body: When several cats are getting ready for adoption in the same country, we send their blood samples together in one DHL shipment, so each cat pays less. It makes international adoption more affordable for everyone.

extras.title: German lab fee
extras.body: Paid by the adopter directly to Viro Vet Diagnostik UG in Germany, the lab we work with for rabies antibody titer testing. Payment instructions come by email. Not included in the Jordan total.

extras.title: Travel crate
extras.body: A standard-size travel crate, including the airline sticker. See the crate sizes below.

extras.title: Flea, tick & deworming
extras.body: Even if a cat is already parasite-free and up to date, the passport and health certificate may need fresh treatments right before travel.

extras.title: Flight & shipping
extras.body: The airline ticket, travel buddy and cargo costs are not included. The transport company sends its own PDF quote, based on the airline, destination and travel plan.

pay.how: Paid directly to the vet or clinic.
Quoted separately by the transport provider.

pay_note: This quote covers the vet preparation and paperwork in Jordan. It does not cover transport and does not guarantee entry approval.
records: Every cat available for adoption has a clear, documented medical file. They are spayed or neutered, vaccinated, and kept up to date with deworming and flea prevention. We share each cat's full health and medical history before adoption, so you know exactly what to expect.
closing_title: You're not just adopting a cat
closing: When you give a rescued cat a home abroad, you give them a second chance at life. Behind every rescue is a long journey of pain, recovery and hope. Rescue work in the Arab world is hard, and every adoption makes a real difference.
crates_note: We use the Stefanplast Gulliver travel crate. Our transport company asked for size 3. We are checking with them whether sizes 1 and 2 are accepted for smaller cats. Always confirm with the airline before buying.
rate_note: Dollar and euro prices are approximate and change with the exchange rate.
